argument_tags.real: Finite signed-int32 integral values use integer text; other magnitudes below 1e21 use fixed two decimal digits with exact binary rounding. Larger values use shortest scientific text.

argument_tags.unsupported: Nonprimitive tags retain named refusal. Full object and caught-array Tag conversion is not claimed.

empty_annotation_callbacks.contract: Pinned doUpdate and update overrides have empty bodies. Invoke exact bound owners without reading controls, writing output receipts, publishing Updated or Rendered, or applying ordinary SafeMode/update_graph wrappers.
empty_annotation_callbacks.step: Inherited source Step still reads its Update getter, resets a triggered local animator, clears Updated and routes metadata under existing authoring and runtime observations.
empty_annotation_callbacks.identity: Exact native, preserved opaque annotation or bounded internal group scratch identity only; no fabricated dynamic outputs or unknown callback capability.
empty_annotation_callbacks.capability: No pixel executor is registered. Constructor output inventory is empty. Canvas drawing, layout, containment and onValueUpdate remain outside this callback contract.
